articles.title: Market recap: Top-10 firms add Rs 2.51 lakh crore; Bajaj Finance biggest winner
articles.summary: India's largest listed firms saw market value increase by Rs 2.51 lakh crore last week. Nine of the top ten most-valued companies experienced valuation gains on Dalal Street.

articles.title: RBI updates deposit rules: From differential rates to daily disclosures, here's what's changing
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has revised rules for bulk deposits, effective October 2026. Banks can now offer differential interest rates based on liquidity risk under the LCR framework.

articles.title: FPIs return to India: Rs 20,200 cr injected into equities after months of selling
articles.summary: Foreign portfolio investors returned to Indian equities in July after four months of outflows. They invested twenty thousand two hundred crore rupees in stocks during July. This renewed interest stems from attractive valuations and improving corporate earnings.

articles.title: Ancient Silk Route to Tibet reopens: India-China trade through Shipki La resumes after six years
articles.summary: Himachal's Revenue and Horticulture Minister flagged off 16 traders after presenting traditional Khataks (ceremonial scarves) along with their horses towards Shipki village in Tibet

articles.title: Dalal Street outlook: RBI policy, earnings and other cues to drive market this week
articles.summary: The stock market faces a crucial week with key domestic and global events. The Reserve Bank of India's interest rate decision is a major focus for investors. Geopolitical developments in West Asia and crude oil prices will also influence sentiment.

articles.title: When gods ruled empires: 4 forgotten religions that shaped civilizations and then vanished
articles.summary: The ancient world was home to thousands of belief systems, many of which dominated entire regions before slipping into obscurity. Yet while their followers disappeared, many of their myths, monuments, and traditions continue to intrigue historians and archaeologists today.

articles.title: Noida Airport just got closer for millions — the Yamuna-EPE interchange opens in October
articles.summary: The Yamuna-EPE cloverleaf interchange near Noida Airport opens around October 15 — cutting 15–20 km and up to 30 minutes off airport travel from Meerut, Greater Noida and Panipat.

articles.title: Capital One says anti-money laundering review led to closure of over 300 Trump Organization accounts
articles.summary: In a significant move, Capital One has closed the Trump Organization's accounts, citing anti-money laundering concerns backed by detailed analysis and adherence to internal policies.

articles.title: IT industry isn't creating enough jobs anymore: Zoho's Sridhar Vembu explains why
articles.summary: The real issue facing our nation is how to create jobs for our massive cohort of youth in this very uncertain global landscape, says Vembu

articles.title: CBI books Anil Ambani, Reliance Capital in ₹1,816 crore EPFO case. Here's what happened
articles.summary: The case originates from a complaint filed by the Union Ministry of Labour and Employment on July 21, alleging offences of cheating, criminal conspiracy and causing wrongful loss to the EPFO

articles.title: India’s worst roads tested these SUVs — here are the ones that survived the toughest drives
articles.summary: India’s rough roads demand more than style. From Tata Punch to Mahindra Scorpio-N, these SUVs offer strong ground clearance, durable suspension and the toughness needed for potholes and bad roads.

articles.title: Passenger vehicle sales hit top gear as July dispatches jump 33%; Maruti, Hyundai set records
articles.summary: India's passenger vehicle sales saw robust growth in July. Leading manufacturers like Maruti Suzuki and Hyundai reported record monthly dispatches. Tata Motors and Mahindra & Mahindra also posted substantial increases in their sales.

articles.title: From snake venom to wigs: India’s weirdest exports hiding inside trade data
articles.summary: India’s export basket hides surprising products beyond smartphones and fuel — from human hair and snake venom to jellyfish, carrom boards and unusual items shipped worldwide.

articles.title: Another attack in Hormuz: Tanker carrying Qatar LNG struck, blackout reported
articles.summary: The carrier reportedly loaded an LNG cargo in Qatar around July 27 and stopped transmitting its tracking signal on July 31 near the western entrance to the Strait of Hormuz

articles.title: 116 metres underground: These are the world’s deepest metro stations hiding below cities
articles.summary: Explore the world’s deepest metro stations hidden beneath cities, from China’s 116-metre Hongyancun to Kyiv’s historic underground marvels built for travel and survival.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Rakesh Jhunjhunwala: ‘I'm not afraid of losing money, I'm afraid of sour relationships’
articles.summary: Rakesh Jhunjhunwala (1960-2022) was a legendary Indian billionaire investor and stock trader often referred to as the “Big Bull” of India or the “Indian Warren Buffett”.

articles.title: No leave needed: 5 cities from Delhi you can explore in a day by Vande Bharat
articles.summary: Delhi travellers can now plan quick one-day getaways to Agra, Jaipur, Haridwar, Chandigarh and Dehradun with Vande Bharat’s faster connectivity, comfort and convenient schedules.

articles.title: Geopolitical tensions could spark inflation beyond oil prices, warns Jefferies
articles.summary: Escalating geopolitical tensions could trigger a broader inflation shock that extends far beyond rising crude oil prices, according to a Jefferies report.

articles.title: Thinking of buying an EV? Top 5 things you need to consider before making the big purchase
articles.summary: Before bringing an electric car home, there are a few practical factors you should consider to avoid unexpected expenses and regrets later.

articles.title: Zepto to raise funds amid delayed listing
5.9 crore returns filed till July 31 deadline: I-T dept
articles.summary: Nearly 5.9 crore income tax returns were filed by the July 31 deadline. This number is lower than last year's extended filing period. Major tax concessions were announced during the last financial year. Taxpayers can still file returns until December with a penalty.

articles.title: UPI transactions touch Rs 76cr/day, FASTag declines
articles.summary: UPI processed 2,366 crore transactions in July, showing significant year-on-year growth. NETC FASTag transactions declined by 6% compared to the previous year. The value of UPI transactions rose to Rs 29.88 lakh crore in July.

articles.title: Forex mop up under RBI's swap scheme doubles to over $40bn
articles.summary: Total forex mobilization under RBI's concessional dollar swap facility has exceeded forty billion dollars. This amount more than doubled in just a fortnight, surpassing previous deposit drives.

articles.title: July auto sales rev up as Maruti crosses 2L, Tata EVs double
articles.summary: Several automakers achieved record July sales, largely due to new sport utility vehicle launches. Maruti Suzuki and Tata Motors reported significant year-on-year growth in their passenger vehicle segments.

articles.title: July GST collections up 15.4% to Rs 2.1 L cr on higher imports
articles.summary: Goods and Services Tax collections rose 15.4 percent to Rs 2,11,205 crore in July. This increase was largely due to a 29 percent jump in integrated GST on imports. Strong economic activity and higher commodity prices also contributed to the robust tax collections.

articles.title: UPI reaches new milestone in July with highest-ever transaction value of Rs 29.88 lakh crore
articles.summary: India's UPI platform achieved its highest monthly transaction value ever. In July, transaction volumes also reached a new record high. The platform processed billions of transactions, surpassing previous records.

articles.title: Indian equities ‘probably oversold’: FIIs warm up after months of outflows
articles.summary: Foreign investors are showing renewed interest in Indian equities after significant outflows. Geopolitical uncertainties and elevated oil prices continue to pose risks to the outlook. India's domestic economy demonstrates robust performance with healthy sales and credit growth.

articles.title: Samudra Manthan explained: How India’s offshore oil & gas exploration scheme can be a game-changer
articles.summary: The Samudra Manthan – National Offshore Exploration Scheme aims to unlock India’s offshore oil and gas potential. This will be done through large-scale seismic surveys, deepwater exploration, scientific drilling.

articles.title: Why Air India is betting bigger on Canada new Mumbai-Toronto flights and new Dreamliner
articles.summary: Beginning October 25, 2026, Air India will introduce a three-times-weekly non-stop service between Mumbai and Toronto, becoming the only airline offering direct flights between the two cities.

articles.title: Indian Oil ramps up spot crude purchases as Middle East disruptions hit supplies
articles.summary: Indian Oil Corporation has significantly increased its spot crude purchases to nearly eighty-four percent. This strategic shift occurred after Middle East supply routes faced disruptions. The company also diversified imports from West Africa and Latin America.

articles.title: ₹12 lakh in just days? Viral post on Pune CA's ITR earnings sparks debate amid ITR filing
articles.summary: The post triggered mixed reactions across the internet. Many users defended the high earnings, citing the rigorous years of study, exhaustive examinations, and specialized expertise required to qualify as a CA.

articles.title: Forex boost: RBI's special swap facility draws $40.8 bn in foreign inflows
articles.summary: Foreign exchange inflows under RBI's special swap facility reached $40.816 billion by July end. This figure nearly doubled from $20.718 billion reported just two weeks prior. FCNR(B) deposits were the primary driver, contributing $36.725 billion to the total collections.

articles.title: BT Explainer: Air India back with its long-haul monopoly as IndiGo ends widebody operations
articles.summary: A challenging operating environment triggered by the ongoing geopolitical tensions led IndiGo to conclude its long-haul operations.

articles.title: US crude bound for Israel for first time since 2023
articles.summary: A US crude oil cargo is heading to Israel after almost three years. The Aframax tanker Captain John loaded the oil in Texas on Thursday. This shipment carries approximately 550,000 barrels of West Texas Intermediate crude.

articles.title: FCNR(B) deposits contribute over 90% of $40.82 bn raised under RBI's forex swap scheme
articles.summary: According to data released by the central bank on Saturday, total inflows under the scheme reached $40.816 billion as of July 31, reflecting sustained participation by banks and non-resident depositors.

articles.title: GST collections jump 15.4% to over Rs 2.11 lakh crore in July
articles.summary: India's gross Goods and Services Tax collections reached over Rs 2.11 lakh crore in July. This represents a significant 15.4 percent increase compared to the previous year. Higher revenues from both domestic transactions and imports contributed to this strong performance.

articles.title: GST collections jump 15.4% to ₹2.11 lakh crore in July, import tax revenues surge nearly 29%
articles.summary: India's GST collections continued their strong momentum in July, with gross revenues rising 15.4% year-on-year to ₹2.11 lakh crore, driven by robust domestic collections and a sharp jump in tax receipts from imports.

articles.title: Sebi bars Subhash Chandra, Punit Goenka from securities market for one year over ZEEL land pledge
articles.summary: In its 150-page final order issued on Friday, the market regulator also imposed monetary penalties totalling ₹1.48 crore on Chandra and Goenka. ZEEL has been fined ₹30 lakh and prohibited from accessing the securities market for two months.

articles.title: RBI likely to keep repo rate unchanged in August as inflation, global risks outweigh strong GDP growth: SBI Research
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is likely to keep the repo rate unchanged at its August 3-5 Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting despite stronger-than-expected economic growth, according to SBI Research.

articles.title: PM Modi to inaugurate Rs 5,640-crore Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport in Andhra Pradesh — See pics
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurates the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport on Saturday. He will also lay foundation stones for significant development projects worth over seventeen thousand nine hundred crore.
